title: Lumen-Quest VR
description: Developed with Unreal Engine for the Meta Quest, Lumen-Quest is an immersive VR simulation designed to streamline the lighting design process. Users sit within a physical vehicle mockup while navigating a digital showroom to interactively manipulate pre-configured lighting components. By dragging and placing these modules into specific spatial coordinates, designers can instantly visualize high-fidelity light-and-shadow effects in real-time. This "First-Person Simulation" serves as a critical decision-making tool, allowing for the rapid evaluation of lighting schemes and architectural forms before advancing to the final development stage.
